archetypes.name: dyn-ast-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: AST matching and occurrence semantics are the highest-risk part of the new lint.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new lifecycle-prefix literal lint's AST traversal. Focus on comparison, membership, method-call, and regex contexts, plus occurrence counting before suppression. Check that casefolding and trailing-space handling derive from shared constants without hardcoded token lists. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
